blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — Hakeem Jeffries vowed Wednesday to “hold the crooks accountable” after Democrats nominated him to become the first Black speaker of the US House of Representatives, setting the stage for two years of confrontation with President Donald Trump. The 56-year-old New Yorker is poised to preside over a commanding Democratic majority following his party’s sweeping midterm election victory, as his lawmakers prepare to reverse Republican policies and investigate the Trump administration. Jeffries faced no declared challenger in the closed-door party election, but resistance from some newly elected progressives highlighted divisions over how Democrats should wield their newfound power. “We’re […]...
